(diesec.com) Critical Zammad Zero-Day Vulnerabilities Exploited in AI-Driven Attack Chain In brief - This article describes the exploitation

via Mastodon https://diesec.com/2026/10/zammad-zero-day-vulnerabilities-cve-2026-102489-102490/

CVE-2026-102489.evidence: diesec.com reports the two Zammad zero-days (CVE-2026-102489, CVE-2026-102490) exploited in an AI-driven attack chain, consistent with the exploitation already reported across this story.

CVE-2026-102490.evidence: Same diesec.com report: both zero-days used together in the observed AI-driven attack chain against Zammad instances.
